title: nb lint: drift and stale-interim warnings stop once a design is done
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC lint table puts no status condition on either row.

- Drift is checked only for `draft` and `frozen` designs (`lint`, `bin/nb` line 2099). Reproduced: the warning disappears after `nb status <xpl> done`, while `nb path` still reports the drift.
- `stale_interim` (line 626) requires `frozen`, so a done exploration with only an old interim result is not flagged in lint or in prime's Needs closing.

Related: the issue about explorations going done on an interim-only result.
